description: Get currency exchange rates for 200+ fiat and crypto currencies with optional historical dates (fawazahmed0 CDN)

base.description: Base currency code (e.g. "usd", "eur", "btc"). Lowercase. 200+ currencies supported.

currencies.description: Filter to specific target currencies (e.g. ["eur","gbp"]). Omit for all.

date.description: Historical date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Omit for latest rates.

name: finance.currency.rates

error.description: Present only when the call failed. Includes error code, message, request_id, and any provider-specific extras.

result.description: Tool response payload. Shape varies per tool — consult the tool description and inputSchema. May be an object, array, string, or number depending on the upstream provider response.

title: Get Exchange Rates
